q: How can I check my savings account balance?
a: You can view your real-time balance in the mobile app dashboard or dial the missed-call balance service from your registered mobile number.

q: What is the limit for instant fund transfers?
a: Instant transfers via IMPS allow up to ₹5 lakh per day when initiated through Internet Banking with OTP confirmation.

q: How do I block my lost debit card?
a: Open the mobile app > Cards > Manage Card and choose Block Card, or call the 24x7 emergency helpline immediately.

q: Can I request a new debit card PIN online?
a: Yes, use the Generate PIN option under Card Services in Internet Banking and authenticate with your OTP.

q: How do I change the EMI date for my loan?
a: Submit an EMI reschedule request through the loan dashboard at least 7 working days before the current due date.

q: What is the current personal loan interest rate?
a: Personal loans presently start at 12.5% per annum, with final rates based on credit profile and tenure.

q: How do I download my bank statement?
a: Navigate to Accounts > Download Statement in Internet Banking and export a PDF or Excel file for the selected period.

q: How can I update my communication address?
a: Visit Profile > Contact Details in the app, upload a valid address proof, and confirm with OTP to update instantly.

q: How do I enable international transactions on my card?
a: Enable International Usage from Card Controls in the app, set your preferred limits, and confirm with OTP before travel.

q: What are the customer care working hours?
a: Our phone banking officers are available 8 AM to 8 PM on weekdays, while digital self-service channels run 24x7.

q: How do I pay off my home loan early?
a: You can raise a part-prepayment request under Loan Services, choose the debit account, and authorize the transaction with OTP.

q: Is there a fee for UPI payments?
a: There is no fee for UPI payments up to ₹1 lakh per transaction for retail customers.
